visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A first-person perspective shows male hands holding a Nintendo Switch. The Switch screen displays the live-feed from a Mario Kart toy kart. In the physical space ahead, several women in various states of dress (lingerie, body suits) are lying on a wooden floor, acting as creative obstacles. (2) The camera focus shifts as the toy kart moves forward, passing through cardboard gates branded with the TRE logo. The women on the floor adjust their poses slightly, looking toward the camera or the kart. The background features brick walls, a leather sofa, and cafe-style furniture. (3) A sharp cut transitions to a close-up of a specific woman with short dark hair sitting cross-legged on the floor. She is wearing a black crop top with the TRE logo and denim shorts. She holds up a red promotional card with white text and waves cheerfully with her right hand while smiling directly at the lens.
